plan: Design document delivered in English Markdown, 10 sections in the requested order. Design-only per submission contract; no execution, no invented numbers, no simulated logs. Sections: (1) Objective and H1/H0/H_ni with formal notation; (2) Independent variables 7B primary and 13B confirmatory with fp16 and shared tokenizer lineage; (3) Dependent variables per-task accuracy, macro-mean, delta vector, win-loss-tie, d_z; (4) Materials with external model artifact references, lm-evaluation-harness v0.4.5 pin, the 9 CS task identifier strings listed, dataset reference paths; (5) Procedure as 7 deterministic steps with all settings pinned; (6) Controls (8 locked factors) and 5 threats to validity including tokenizer check and contamination; (7) Analysis plan with permutation test primary, BCa bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon, Cohen d_z, three-way verdict taxonomy outperfoms/non-inferior/no effect with 1pp non-inferiority margin; (8) Feasibility assessment for 1xA100-80GB with memory and wall-clock ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE estimates and n=9 power note; (9) Reporting template with per-scale table schema and verdict line and provenance footer; (10) Limitations.
